meta.title: Feature Articles on the Home Page
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Feature Articles on the Home Page".

steps.title: Company Overview
steps.text: We are a company dedicated to providing quality products and services to our customers.

steps.title: Meet the Team
steps.text: Our team brings together experienced professionals from across the industry, united by a shared commitment to quality.

steps.title: Our Locations
steps.text: We operate offices in multiple cities, each staffed by local experts ready to help.

steps.title: Our Mission
steps.text: Our mission is to deliver reliable products and outstanding service to every customer we serve.

steps.title: Our History
steps.text: Founded with a commitment to quality, our company has grown steadily while staying true to its founding values.

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Feature Articles on the Home Page', 'joomlaguide-featured-articles', '

Featured articles get special attention: they are shown on the home page of your site.

In this tour you see why, and you feature two articles: Company Overview in its edit form and Meet the Team straight from the list of articles.

This tour follows the tutorial 2.4 Featuring Articles on the Homepage of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_menus","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 2.4 Featuring Articles on the Homepage', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Menus', '

In the menu on the left, click Menus.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Menus › Main Menu', '

Click Main Menu in Menus.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'The Home menu item', '

This list holds the menu items of the Main Menu. Below the title of each one you see its Menu Item Type.

Home is a menu item of the type Articles » Featured Articles: the home page shows the featured articles.

', 3, 'bottom', '#menuitemList tbody tr:has(.icon-home)', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 4, 'right', 'body.com_menus.view-items #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 5, 'right', 'body.com_menus.view-items #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_menus&view=items&menutype=mainmenu', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Open Company Overview', '

Click Company Overview to open it.

', 6, 'right', '.view-articles a[title$=" Company Overview"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Featured', '

Set Featured to Yes.

Then click Next.

', 7, 'left', '.view-article #jform_featured', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 8, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'A featured article', '

The column Featured now shows a gold star for Company Overview.

Look at your site: click the button with your site\'s name in the header at the top (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar). Company Overview is on the home page.

Then come back here and click Next.

', 9, 'right', '#articleList tr:has(a[title$=" Company Overview"]) [data-item-task="articles.unfeatured"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Feature from the list', '

You do not have to open an article to feature it.

Click the grey icon in the column Featured of Meet the Team.

', 10, 'right', '#articleList tr:has(a[title$=" Meet the Team"]) [data-item-task="articles.featured"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-featured-articles'), 'Well done!', '

Joomla says Article featured. and the icon is now a gold star. Click it again to undo it.

Look at your site again: the home page shows Company Overview and Meet the Team. Featuring works the same for an article in a sub-category.

', 11, 'right', '#articleList tr:has(a[title$=" Meet the Team"]) [data-item-task="articles.unfeatured"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
